about: teacher_training E41 (reports/plans/2026-10-28_plan_e41-teacher-path.md; technique-comparison gap 3). Teachers: E34's Adam 3e-5 arm-A fine-tune (all 24 matrices, batch 32, seed 0) of emoticon and r1_t534_v369, regenerated in-job, at steps 10, 100, 1000 (T10, T100, T1000; one fine-tune, constant rate). Teacher training: E34's recipe (Adam 1e-5, 1,000 steps, batch-order seed 0; arm A task windows with arm A's weighting, batch 32; arm B Pile train rows from 32,768, batch 8, plain mean KL), Gamma and Delta frozen. One-shot = from W0's (U, V); chain = from the T10 one-shot copy against T100, then from that against T1000, fresh Adam per link. Arms: emoticon A and B, r1 A. Every copy read at its step 1000 through E34's harness. RunPod H100. Filed before any run

controls.C1: first, alone: W0 under the Pile harness (256 Pile val rows, 20-step adversary, seeds 0, 1, 2), faith_score.w0_check passes and the PGD floor is 0.0748 within 10%. Fails: stop, nothing trained
controls.C2: before the first chain link: from the emoticon T10 arm-A copy's offsets via component_training.train's init, one step at lr 0 against that copy's own weights; step-1 KL <= 0.005 nats (E34's hook-path floor 0.0007) and delta-W unchanged to 1e-3 of its largest entry (bf16 offsets would read about 4e-3). Fails: stop
controls.G1: per task, after the fine-tune: T1000's held-out P(target) within 0.005 and size within 0.001 of E34's (emoticon 0.99961, 0.03209; r1 0.99621, 0.03334). Fails: stop
controls.G3: per task, the first copy: the one-shot arm-A copy of T1000 reproduces E34's (P within 0.005, adversarial ratio within 15% relative; emoticon 0.99675, 0.9591; r1 0.99443, 0.9676). Fails: stop
controls.do-nothing: per task, before any copy: the do-nothing state of T10, T100, T1000 through the harness. Expected (H100, E22 and E34): emoticon 2.52 fail, 1.14 pass, 1.50 inconclusive; r1 T1000 1.52 inconclusive, T10 and T100 unknown. Emoticon T10 is the positive control: the check sees that update. Not a stop; P1 reports per cell whether the do-nothing state is above the pass band

expected.W0: ratios 1; gap share 1; P(target) 0.004 emoticon, 0.04 r1
expected.noise: Amendment 4's batch-order spread at step 1000: P 0.005 (task text) / 0.032 (Pile text); gap share 0.002 / 0.010; adversarial ratio up to 11% (task text) / 25% (Pile text); W0's adversary-seed floor 7.5%
expected.references: one-shot T1000 copies as E34 seed 0: emoticon A P 0.997 ratio 0.96 gap share 0.006; emoticon B P 0.902 ratio 1.05 gap share 0.027; r1 A P 0.994 ratio 0.97 gap share 0.004

measurements.cosine: finetune.cosines 'all' between the chained and one-shot T1000 copies' weight changes; references Amendment 5's batch-order cosines 0.913 (task text), 0.429 (Pile text); null about 2e-4
measurements.gap share: teacher gap of the state / teacher gap of W0, against the same teacher (held-out task windows, arm A's weighting). W0 1, do-nothing 0. Blind to text outside the task windows
measurements.seven numbers: per state as E34 (run.record): adversarial and stochastic ratios to this job's W0 (seed 0) with faith_score.state_verdict against the same-job floor (pass <= 1.396, fail >= 1.612 at floor 0.0748; P(target) < 0.9 reads 'below P 0.9'), held-out P(target), teacher gap, damage, size, Delta's share
measurements.start KL: the student's loss at step 1 (before the first update) on the first batch, the same batch for every copy of an arm (seed 0): the one-shot's is W0's distance to the teacher, the chain's its head start

predictions.blind_to: one seed, one adversary start (a pass is a lower bound), two trigger tasks, Adam teachers only
predictions.lean: high (E34: all six task-text copies passed; the early teachers are smaller)
predictions.rule: for each task with arm A and each early teacher (T10, T100) with P(target) >= 0.9: the one-shot arm-A copy at step 1000 'works': state_verdict 'pass' and gap share <= 0.05. Holds if every such cell works; unscored if there is no such cell or one is missing. Reported per cell: whether the do-nothing state of that teacher reads 'fail' or 'inconclusive' (the check sees the update)

predictions.lean: learnt, low (E34's Pile-text copy of T1000 read P 0.902, at the line; Amendment 2 showed it leans on the trigger rows)
predictions.rule: emoticon, each early teacher with P(target) >= 0.9: the one-shot arm-B copy at step 1000 is 'learnt' if it works (as P1), 'neither' if P(target) < 0.5, 'between' otherwise; overall 'learnt' if both are, 'neither' if both are, else 'between'; unscored if a cell is missing

predictions.blind_to: the chain has 2,000-3,000 student steps against the one-shot's 1,000 (named, not removed); links of 1,000 steps, not the short links a per-step map would use; one seed
predictions.lean: high (each link is a full E34 copy; the start is the only difference)
predictions.rule: for each task with arm A, at T100 and at T1000: the chained copy against the one-shot copy of the same teacher is not worse: verdict 'pass' wherever the one-shot's is, adversarial ratio <= 1.25 x the one-shot's, P(target) >= the one-shot's - 0.01, gap share <= the one-shot's + 0.005. Holds if all four comparisons do; unscored if one is missing

predictions.lean: holds, medium (Pile-text copies land at different weight changes from batch order alone, Amendment 5 cosine 0.43, with the same behaviour)
predictions.rule: emoticon arm B, at T100 and at T1000: as P3 with tolerances 1.25 x on the ratio, 0.05 on P(target), 0.02 on the gap share
